subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y10 lesson 61 (Own 4GE1-style exam questions with indicative mark points (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 61: Case study: coastal management in Bangladesh, a developing country (2.3). Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Case study fact file, then: 'Assess the success of coastal management in a named area in a developing or emerging country.' Portal response box.
questions.a: Specific Bangladesh evidence; strengths and limits; judgement
questions.model: Teacher plans the answer with the class.

questions.q: Compare management at Holderness and in Bangladesh.
questions.a: Different threats, costs and methods; both face sea-level rise

questions.q: Explain why Bangladesh is vulnerable to coastal flooding.
questions.a: Low-lying delta (1) with a funnel-shaped bay that amplifies surges (1); dense population (1) and poverty limit protection (1)
questions.model: Physical: low delta + funnel bay. Human: many people + poverty. Two of each = 4 marks.
